def check_s_palindrome(s):
    n = len(s)
    if n % 2 == 0:
        mid = n // 2
        return "TAK" if s[:mid] == s[mid:][::-1] else "NIE"
    else:
        mid = n // 2
        return "TAK" if s[:mid] == s[mid + 1:][::-1] else "NIE"
